summary: The immunohistochemical study was conducted using an automated Ventana machine on 3-micron-thick tissue sections, with diaminobenzidine (DAB) used as the chromogen for visualizing the antigen-antibody complex [C1:S1|PMC11503264|446]. The study assessed the percentage of positive tumor cells and staining intensity, both scored semi-quantitatively [C1:S1|PMC11503264|446]. A histoscore was calculated by multiplying these two scores, and adnexal structures were used as internal positive controls [C1:S1|PMC11503264|446].
